assertions.assertion: The denial was issued under CARC code CO-197.
CPT 93229 corresponds to mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring.
The denial pertains to episode ep-05050.
There is a clinical indication note documenting the patient's presentation.
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope accompanied by palpitations.
The symptoms raise concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
The claim was submitted with diagnosis codes R55 and I47.1.
The symptoms are intermittent in nature.
There is a need for continuous rhythm correlation during daily activities.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered to capture potential arrhythmic events.
Reconsideration is requested on medical necessity grounds.
